latest_release.name: 03 November 2026
latest_release.body:
The following packages have been updated
```
@keystone-6/core@8.3.0
```

#### New Features
- `[core]` Adds support for context functions in list labels, field labels and descriptions, and group labels and descriptions (#10025) @MauriceArikoglu

#### Bug Fixes
- `[core]` Fixes empty, not empty and is not filters for relationship fields in the Admin UI (#10087) @emmatown
- `[core]` Skips unnecessary printing and parsing of GraphQL documents in `context.graphql.{run,raw}` and cache GraphQL validation by document identity (#10077) @emmatown

#### :eyes: Review
See https://github.com/keystonejs/keystone/compare/2026-10-27...2026-11-03 to compare with our previous release.
